command.doc: dispatch one command line to the service, as the window and solaris-cc do; `wait` is refused (watch the events instead)

line.doc: one line of the Solaris command grammar (R-SVC-1) - every command is in apps/solaris/docs/API.md, and the `commands` method lists them

command.result: {output, revision} - output is what the command printed; a refusal fails with its reason

model.doc: the whole AppModel as JSON (what `state print --json` prints)

commands.doc: the command grammar: every command with its usage and summary

info.doc: A note worth logging; carries no state.

error.doc: Something failed. Also set as AppModel.lastError.

command.rejected.doc: A line was refused (R-SVC-3): unknown verb, flag, address or parameter; a refused edit.

project.changed.doc: A node was added, removed, moved or re-routed. what = e.g. strip.added, clip.moved, route.set. Every node a command makes is announced, one event each (R-SVC-8).

params.changed.doc: An address was written; value is what was STORED, canonical (a value out of range is refused, never clamped — R-SVC-8).

render.finished.doc: A render was written; peak is the master's, dBFS.

render.failed.doc: A render stopped with an error.

settings.changed.doc: A machine setting changed and was saved: sampleRate, bufferSize, output, input, port.<name>, folders.

browse.changed.doc: The browser now lists this folder.

transport.changed.doc: Play, stop, seek or loop: playing 1/0, position in beats, loop `from-to` or `off`.

audition.changed.doc: A sample previewed from the browser started (playing 1) or ended — stopped, or to its end (playing 0).

model.doc: the AppModel (state print --json), pushed on every revision (at most 25/s)

transport.doc: what moves without an edit, pushed when it changed (at most 20/s)
transport.data: {playing, position, loopFrom, loopTo, latencyMs, masterPeak, peaks: {<strip>: [l, r]}, audition, auditionPlaying, auditionProgress}
